findings.message: GameRoundSummary's doc comment described the accuracy rule as 'rating >= 3, matching ratingFromCorrectness', which contradicts the actually-implemented and AC3-tested rule (only ratings 4/5 count as correct) in PlayGameUseCase.finishRound. The 1.3 executor's own summary flagged this exact mismatch but left it for a later pass ('flagging the mismatch as a finding instead'). Fixed by rewriting the doc comment to state the Good/Easy-only threshold and explicitly note it differs from ReviewService's >=3 convention, matching PlayGameUseCase.ts and its passing AC3 test exactly. No behavior changed; npm run build and the domain/application test scopes were re-run green after the edit.
